text: What are you doing here?

text: Hhrrrnnn.
source_text: Hhrrrnnn.

text: Nothing. Honest.

text: I'm just looking around.

text: This! *smack*

text: A moron. I think that you'd best get out of here. Otherwise, you may become target practice.

text: Arroo!

text: Nothing, eh? I think you're hiding something. Out with it before you see your guts.

Nothing, eh? I think you're hiding something. Out with it
 before you see your guts.

text: I'm really a Martian.
source_text: I'm really a Martian.

text: I'm here to stop the gang wars.
source_text: I'm here to stop the gang wars.

text: I'm not up to anything.
source_text: I'm not up to anything.

text: I'm up to THIS! *smack*
source_text: I'm up to THIS! *smack*

text: Everyone knows there are no such things as Martians. All real aliens are from Venus. Now, you die!
source_text:
Everyone knows there are no such things as Martians.
 All real aliens are from Venus. Now, you die!

text: Sure, and I'm the Queen of Mexico.
source_text: Sure, and I'm the Queen of Mexico.

text: Honest. I want to stop the wars so I can help Adytum.
source_text: Honest. I want to stop the wars so I can help Adytum.

text: Your Majesty, I truly seek to end the wars.
source_text: Your Majesty, I truly seek to end the wars.

text: If your intelligence were greater, I would try to explain the benefits of peace.
source_text:
If your intelligence were greater, I would try to
 explain the benefits of peace.

text: If you're here to do that, then you'll need to try and find Razor. She'll let you know what we think of that.
source_text:
If you're here to do that, then you'll need to try and find
 Razor. She'll let you know what we think of that.

text: Uh, thanks. I think.
source_text: Uh, thanks. I think.

text: Okay. Good bye.
source_text: Okay. Good bye.

text: Mock me, will you? I guess I should expect as much from a child. Oh, by the way. Here!
source_text:
Mock me, will you? I guess I should expect as much from a
 child. Oh, by the way. Here!

text: Fancy talk will only get you so far. Here, it will get you about six feet under.
source_text:
Fancy talk will only get you so far. Here, it will get

text: If you are up to nothing, then we will put you up to something. I think 'target' makes a good something.
source_text:
If you are up to nothing, then we will put you up to
 something. I think 'target' makes a good something.

text: You looked. Now, what do you want? Think quick. It may mean the difference between walking out of here and becoming a permanent resident.
source_text:
You looked. Now, what do you want? Think quick. It may mean
 the difference between walking out of here and becoming
 a permanent resident.

text: I'd like to live here.
source_text: I'd like to live here.

text: I'm really a Ripper in disguise.
source_text: I'm really a Ripper in disguise.

text: I want to bring peace to the gangs.
source_text: I want to bring peace to the gangs.

text: Leaving.
source_text: Leaving.

text: Nothing special. Just looking at the garbage to be recycled.

Nothing special. Just looking at the garbage to be
 recycled.

text: We never said anything about living. You would just reside here. Indefinitely. Enjoy your stay.
source_text:
We never said anything about living. You would just

text: I'm glad you said that. I've been meaning to sharpen this.
source_text: I'm glad you said that. I've been meaning to sharpen this.

text: Soon I will have a hide to sharpen it on.
source_text: Soon I will have a hide to sharpen it on.

text: Not so fast. The only way someone leaves here is if they are a Blade, or in a bag.
source_text:
Not so fast. The only way someone leaves here is if they
 are a Blade, or in a bag.

text: Then I want to be a Blade.
source_text: Then I want to be a Blade.

text: How big is this bag?
source_text: How big is this bag?

text: You forget the third option. Me!
source_text: You forget the third option. Me!

text: Fat chance. But, he's a test. If you can find Razor, then you can talk to her about that.
source_text:
Fat chance. But, he's a test. If you can find Razor, then
 you can talk to her about that.

text: Big enough to stuff your body parts in when we finish.
source_text: Big enough to stuff your body parts in when we finish.

text: I am not Sleeping Beauty. I do not need to be awakened. Get out or die.
source_text:
I am not Sleeping Beauty. I do not need to be awakened.
 Get out or die.

text: Hear you're out for the bastard's head. Give him an extra knife twist for me.
source_text:

text: Welcome back. The Hole is open and ready to house you once more.
